TS052 no-panic-recovery

A crash stays a crash, because a recovered panic runs on from state the program has already proven wrong.

languages: go javascript python rust typescript
severity: error
default: on
group: stable
odin: Odin has no way to recover from a panic; an assertion failure ends the process
zig: Zig has no way to recover from a panic; the panic handler does not return

TigerStyle: "Assertions detect programmer errors. Unlike operating errors, which are expected and which must be handled, assertion failures are unexpected. The only correct way to handle corrupt code is to crash."
NASA P10 Rule 1: "Restrict all code to very simple control flow constructs; do not use goto statements, setjmp or longjmp constructs, and direct or indirect recursion."
